evals.name: focused-equation-explanation
evals.prompt: 解释这篇论文的公式 4：每个符号是什么意思，它解决什么问题，和前后公式有什么关系？
evals.expected_output: A focused conversational explanation with paper locators, assumptions, and a small example. A lightweight .study checklist and teaching transcript are maintained.
expectations: The response establishes the paper version and reads the relevant surrounding source.
Every necessary symbol and assumption is defined.
Paper statements and interpretation are distinguishable.
.study/TODO.md lists observable teaching objectives with Markdown checkboxes.
An objective is checked only after the learner demonstrates understanding or explicitly confirms resolution.
A passed objective's teaching exchange is appended to .study/STUDY.md before its checkbox is checked.
No notes/, SUMMARY.CARD.md, ideas/, REPRODUCT.md, or reproduce/ artifact is created.

evals.name: read-only-official-code-mapping
evals.prompt: 看看官方仓库里论文的损失函数具体在哪实现，并解释代码和论文公式有什么差异。
evals.expected_output: A read-only paper-to-code mapping pinned to a repository revision, without environment setup, code changes, or execution.
expectations: The response traces the relevant executed code path rather than relying only on filenames or README text.
Paper requirements, repository choices, and mismatches are separated.
The learning objectives and completed teaching exchanges are tracked under .study/.
The task is not relabeled as reproduction and no reproduction artifacts are created.

evals.name: complete-notes-boundary
evals.prompt: 请把整篇论文做成分章节 Markdown 精读笔记和主动回忆卡。
evals.expected_output: The request is recognized as belonging to writing-paper-notes rather than study-paper.
expectations: study-paper does not attempt to generate the durable artifact set.
